newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's JSE closed for the day - dealers.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's JSE closed for the day - dealers.

text.p: Dealers said on Wednesday the Johannesburg Stock Exchange had closed for the day after problems with its electronic trading system had halted trade for almost the entire day.
They said the market briefly opened at 1320 GMT but was closed again some 15 minutes later since some brokerage houses could not log onto the system.
The JSE could not be reached for comment.
The only other trading during the day was some 17 minutes activity around midday.
The system failed twice on Monday after the installation of of new software at the weekend and the opening was delayed for an hour on Tuesday.
